**Description:**
To achieve a truly trustless frontend, clients must verify their own state without blindly trusting the Soroban RPC. Implementing an SPV-like light client in the browser requires parsing the Stellar ledger headers and verifying Merkle proofs. To do this efficiently, we need a custom Rust-to-WASM implementation of probabilistic data structures (like Cuckoo Filters or optimized Bloom Filters) to manage the massive amount of state data with minimal memory footprint.

**Requirements & Complexity:**
- **WASM Memory Management:** Implement zero-copy deserialization of XDR ledger proofs directly in WASM memory.
- **Cuckoo Filter Implementation:** Build a highly optimized, memory-bounded filter for lightning-fast inclusion verification of commitments.
- **Challenge:** Handling Javascript/WASM bridging overhead and keeping the browser main thread perfectly unblocked while processing dense cryptographic proofs.

Implementation Proposal: WASM Light Client, Zero-Copy XDR Proof Parsing & Cuckoo Filter for Trustless State VerificationOverview & Strategy:To enable browser-side trustless state verification without relying on central RPC trust, I will implement a Rust-to-WASM SPV (Simple Payment Verification) light client engine.The architecture features a custom, memory-bounded Cuckoo Filter for fast $O(1)$ state commitment inclusion queries alongside zero-copy XDR deserialization directly across the JS/WASM memory boundary. Heavy proof parsing and cryptographic verification will execute off the main thread inside a Web Worker to ensure 60 FPS UI performance.Technical Approach┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                           BROWSER CLIENT ARCHITECTURE                   │
│                                                                         │
│  [Main Thread UI] ──── MessageChannel / SharedArrayBuffer ────┐         │
│                                                               │         │
│                                                               ▼         │
│  [Web Worker Thread] ─── zero-copy ───> [WASM Core]                     │
│                                           │                             │
│                                           ├── XDR Zero-Copy Parser      │
│                                           ├── Cuckoo Filter (State)     │
│                                           └── Merkle Proof Verifier     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
1. Zero-Copy XDR Deserialization & Memory ManagementSharedArrayBuffer / Direct Memory Layout: Pass raw XDR ledger header buffers directly from JavaScript to WASM linear memory (WebAssembly.Memory), eliminating string/object serialization overhead.Zero-Copy AST Parsing: Implement unsafe slice-based XDR decoding in Rust (zerocopy / byte-level view casts) to parse Stellar LedgerHeader structures, transaction envelopes, and Merkle tree proofs directly in place without heap allocations.2. Optimized Rust-WASM Cuckoo FilterMemory-Bounded Space Efficiency: Build a cache-friendly, byte-packed Cuckoo Filter utilizing 4-slot buckets with $x$-$or$-based fingerprinting ($O(1)$ lookup, insertions, and deletion support).Probabilistic Verification Engine: Enable instant inclusion filtering of sub-state commitments and account keys, dropping membership lookup times below 1ms while consuming a tiny memory footprint (<500KB for thousands of active state keys).3. Asynchronous Worker Architecture (Zero Main-Thread Blocking)Web Worker Offloading: Wrap the WASM light client inside a dedicated Web Worker via comlink or raw postMessage streams.Non-Blocking Proof Verification: Offload Stellar ledger header hash chain validation and Merkle inclusion proofs to worker threads, returning clean boolean flags and validated balance states to the JS main thread without frame drops.Deliverables & PlanRust-WASM Core Module: spv-light-client crate containing zero-copy XDR parsing logic and the Cuckoo Filter implementation compiled via wasm-pack.TypeScript Web Worker Integration: A lightweight JS/TS client wrapper managing worker instantiation, memory allocation, and async RPC header stream processing.Performance Benchmarks & Test Suite:Benchmarks showing zero main-thread blocking during proof processing.WASM memory profiling assertions proving sub-millisecond Cuckoo Filter lookup times.Unit and integration tests verifying Merkle proof validation correctness against valid and corrupted Stellar ledger headers.Relevant Experience & QualificationsRust & WASM Optimization: Extensive background building performance-critical Rust libraries compiled to WASM with manual memory layout control.Cryptographic Light Clients & XDR: Deep understanding of Stellar/Soroban XDR structures, Merkle proof trees, and client-side probabilistic data structures.Browser Thread Management: Strong experience structuring Web Worker memory-sharing models for heavy cryptography.Ready to start immediately upon assignment.
